description: Opens one attachment of a message, by its number in read_message. Text comes back as text and images as images. Anything else, like a PDF, needs save_to: a folder inside the agent's files folder (by default ~/.config/mailcycle/files, or the folders set in MAILCYCLE_FILES_DIR). The file is written there, without overwriting anything, and the path is returned.

index.description: The number shown in brackets in read_message, starting at 0.

save_to.description: A folder inside the agent's files folder to write the file to, instead of returning it.

name: read_attachment
title: Read an attachment
